method: Sum per-task GPUs * (end - start) / 3600. Prefer live PodScheduled or retained Kubernetes Scheduled events; otherwise use observed Kueue admission as a start proxy. End is the later of controller terminal observation and any retained final-container exit.
correction: Prior reports called max(controller duration, available pod duration) conservative. Missing terminal pods made most main-run values controller-only. Controller RUNNING is stamped after PodScheduled and omits some setup; the prior global conservative claim is withdrawn. Historical reports remain unchanged.
limits: This is a reconstruction, not exact provider billing. Admission events are polled observations, and quota admission can precede physical binding. Controller terminal observations include variable bookkeeping and may precede pod deletion.
Old terminal pods were garbage-collected. Exact binding and release times cannot be recovered for every attempt; these point estimates are not certified upper or lower bounds.

Five preempted pre-execution task identities disappeared from current controller attempts. Retained events recover them. Their observed quota-reservation interval is separate from the reconstructed executed-task total; do not charge the intervening requeue wait.
Primary training-cycle wall times and all learning metrics are unchanged. This correction applies only to aggregate resource accounting.
